d: We are seeking an experienced Supply & Demand Manager to lead forecasting, inventory planning, demand management, and supply optimization across our hospitality and food & beverage operations. The successful candidate will ensure optimal inventory levels, improve forecast accuracy, reduce waste, and maintain product availability while supporting operational and commercial objectives.

This position is ideal for candidates from restaurant groups, hospitality companies, hotel chains, catering operations, food production, or FMCG organizations with extensive experience in SAP ERP systems and advanced Microsoft Excel analytics.
Develop and manage short, medium, and long-term demand forecasts.
Analyze historical sales, seasonality, promotions, events, and operational trends.
Collaborate with Operations, Procurement, Finance, and Commercial teams to improve forecast accuracy.
Monitor forecast deviations and implement corrective actions.
Develop supply plans aligned with business demand requirements.
Ensure optimal stock availability while minimizing excess inventory and waste.
Monitor inventory turnover, stock coverage, and replenishment requirements.
Manage inventory levels across warehouses, central kitchens, restaurants, and hospitality outlets.
Utilize SAP for demand planning, inventory management, procurement coordination, and reporting.
Develop dashboards and KPI reports using advanced Microsoft Excel.
Analyze inventory risks, shortages, slow-moving items, and demand fluctuations.
Support data-driven decision-making through accurate reporting and analysis.
Collaborate closely with Procurement, Logistics, Warehouse, Finance, and Operations teams.
Support new outlet openings, menu launches, promotions, and seasonal demand planning.
Continuously improve forecasting techniques and inventory planning processes.
Reduce stock-outs, excess stock, and obsolete inventory.
Implement supply chain best practices and efficiency initiatives.
Support digital transformation and system enhancement projects.
Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, or Supply Planning.
At least 3 years of experience in a managerial or supervisory capacity.
Strong experience with SAP ERP (SAP MM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Supply Chain, or equivalent).
Power BI experience is highly desirable.
Excellent forecasting and inventory management capabilities.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High attention to detail and commercial awareness.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
q: Company Benefits in accordance with Qatar Labor Law

d: Lead the Operation. Drive Performance. Make Every Order Count.
Behind every successful customer experience is an operation built on precision, efficiency, and strong leadership.

At Boutiqaat, one of the Middle East's leading e-commerce platforms, we're looking for an experienced Operations Area Manager who can lead high-performing teams, optimize warehouse processes, and drive operational excellence.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands the complexities of large-scale operations, and knows how to turn operational challenges into measurable improvements.

As an Operations Area Manager, you'll take ownership of operational performance within your designated area, ensuring seamless coordination across inbound, outbound, inventory, and logistics activities.
You'll lead teams, monitor performance, improve processes, and ensure operational targets are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, safety, and efficiency.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Management, or a related field. An MBA or master's degree is an advantage.
Minimum 8 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or supply chain operations, including at least 3 years in a supervisory role .
Strong experience managing operational teams in a high-volume environment.
Solid understanding of inventory control, stock rotation, warehouse processes, and logistics management.
Proficiency in ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and logistics management systems.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including reporting, dashboards, and data analysis.
Proven ability to improve operational efficiency, manage costs, and deliver against KPIs.
Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Experience in e-commerce, retail distribution, or high-volume fulfillment operations would be particularly valuable.
r: li
Lead and manage warehouse operations across designated operational areas.
li
Oversee inbound receiving, inventory management, order fulfillment, and logistics processes.
li
Drive operational performance by monitoring KPIs, productivity, accuracy, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
li
Lead, coach, and develop supervisors and operational teams to achieve performance targets.
li
Optimize warehouse workflows, space utilization, and resource allocation.
li
Ensure inventory accuracy through effective stock control, cycle counts, and discrepancy management.
li
Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
li
Oversee picking, packing, dispatch, and delivery coordination to ensure timely order fulfillment.
li
Work closely with internal stakeholders and logistics partners to maintain seamless operations.
li
Maintain compliance with operational procedures, quality standards, and workplace safety requirements.
li
Use operational data, reporting, and performance insights to drive informed decisions.
x: At Boutiqaat, operations are central to delivering the speed, accuracy, and service our customers expect.
You'll join a dynamic regional organization where operational excellence directly influences business performance.
You'll have the opportunity to lead teams, introduce improvements, strengthen operational capabilities, and contribute to the continued development of our fulfillment operations.
Your leadership will make a difference, not just to the numbers, but to the people, processes, and customer experiences behind them.
If you're an experienced operations leader who combines strong execution with continuous improvement and a passion for developing teams, we'd like to hear from you.
